verdict.rationale: Entra's API surface is Microsoft Graph. Graph publishes its machine-readable OData CSDL $metadata unauthenticated at the service root, and the vendor-owned msgraph-metadata repository publishes OpenAPI descriptions, so a downloadable spec exists. The probe 404s were on the learn.microsoft.com docs host, not the API host, so they don't contradict this. Missing for 10: an Entra-scoped spec rather than a Graph-wide one, and independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the OpenAPI files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The metadata document ($metadata) is published at the service root
